privacy.verdict_reason: The IN03 social/privacy gate passed all 27 checks, but the role x surface QA04 matrix aborted twice at its own state-restore step with 504 GATEWAY_504 on DELETE /api/relationships/blocks/{blocked}; the remaining ws-ticket/subscription/replay and denial-audit cells were not reached.

venue_meeting_reads.reason: The composed Concert product has no Meeting ProductOwner: ProductOwner dispatch mounts Wall/Social/Intro/Notification/Age/Report/Operations/OwnerMedia/Feed but no Operation::Meeting, and venue_meeting_admission states the bilateral friend read does not exist yet, so every venue-meeting route fails closed with 503. No venue privacy result is claimed.

venue_location_snapshot.reason: PgVenueLocationAuthority::friend_in returns PolicyUnavailable and no VenueLocation product producer is composed, so the /venue/location route has no owner to read.

age_provider_positive.reason: Missing input: an authorized age-verification provider and its signed verified claims. Social consent requires concert_age_owners rows plus verified concert_age_claims for both participants and a configured sharing verifier; no provider credentials, source revision, or claim provenance exist in this checkout.

social_reveal_revoke.reason: Depends on the same authorized age provider/claim input: a create or reveal cannot succeed without verified claims, so the approved/unrelated/expired/revoked/blocked reveal denials cannot be executed against a real grant.

external_oauth_provider.reason: Missing input: external OAuth/social provider client credentials, callback registration and provider test account.

external_mail_or_sms.reason: Missing input: an external mail/SMS delivery provider. Only the owned local HTTP mail sink was exercised for enrollment.

comments_read.reason: Observed 200 in 1230.1 ms with the seeded comment author present: the self-authored comments read returned its data. The millisecond figure is the client-measured wall time around the HTTP request; provenance.comments_ceiling compares it with the 2000 ms gateway budget. Server-side read evidence only; no client-cache, provider or release claim.

blocked_comment_author_filter.reason: The blocked-author comment filter requires a parent author and a blocked comment author in one read; this run seeds one comment by the parent author, so no blocked comment row exists to filter. The blocked event feed, blocked post detail and blocked profile denials did execute. Not claimed as a privacy pass.

client_cache_and_ws_frames.reason: No browser client was run in this backend gate; no client-cache or world-socket frame claim is made. The friend-block invalidation journal rows and the server-side read-time fences are the evidence.
